answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a sunk fee each epoch. A lasting identity grows like a cedar, one ring per epoch. Each epoch the network takes a pulse: every identity shows a fresh heartbeat and pays 30 POA into a burn pool. The kernel of the defence is that the tax is sunk and non-refundable. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 POA per epoch, burned with no return, while one honest agent pays 30 POA once and keeps an undiluted share.
